name: @blue-bee/api-client
description: Blue Bee shared client seam — the typed transport (fetch + injectable token store + single-flight 401→refresh→retry, problem+json→ApiError) and the headless auth/session core (OTP → keychain → /me → logout-even-offline). Imported by BOTH the driver and customer Expo apps so the transport+session is written once. PURE TypeScript: no native imports in this package's entry, so it also loads under Node for the headless integration proofs (each app keeps its own native SecureTokenStore impl of the TokenStore interface).
